task_definition.task_description: Please check whether the Sony WH-1000XM5 in black is in stock, then look up popular alternatives in the same audio category for me and pick one recommendation to buy, reserve 1 unit, and confirm the order. After that, generate an invoice for 1 black Sony WH-1000XM5 using the SAVE15 coupon, send it to alice@company.com with PayPal payment, then check my investment account status, confirm the NASDAQ market is open, get the USD to EUR exchange rate, look up AAPL’s price, build and place an order to sell 2 shares, assess the trade risk for the transaction amount, and finally create a high-priority app summary/alert for this whole shopping and trading workflow.

user_input.query: For user_id user_01 and broker_user_id user_01, please check whether product_id p_sony_xm5_blk, the Sony WH-1000XM5 in black, is in stock in the audio category, then look up popular alternatives in category audio and choose one recommendation for me to buy. Reserve quantity 1 for p_sony_xm5_blk, confirm the order, and note that my items are [{product_id: p_sony_xm5_blk, quantity: 1}] with quantity 1. Then generate an invoice for 1 black Sony WH-1000XM5 using coupon_code SAVE15, send it to alice@company.com, and use payment_gateway paypal with payment_method card. After that, check my investment account status for broker_user_id user_01, confirm that exchange NASDAQ is open, get the USD to EUR rate from from_currency USD to to_currency EUR, look up ticker AAPL’s price, build and place an order to sell sell_quantity 2 shares, assess the trade risk for that transaction amount, and finally create a high-priority app summary/alert for the whole workflow with tags shopping, finance, and audit.
